stem.text: Which description of chromosome structure is correct?

A.text: A chromosome at the beginning of interphase consists of two identical chromatids, each containing one linear molecule of DNA.

B.text: Telomeres are lengths of non-coding DNA found at one end of each chromatid to prevent loss of genes during cell division.

C.text: The two identical chromatids of a chromosome are held together by a centromere in which there is no DNA.

D.text: The very long DNA molecule of each chromatid is coiled and held together by proteins called histones.
